name: leadline
description: Deterministic function-level complexity analysis for Go, Java, JavaScript, C, C++, TypeScript, TSX, Rust, Python, and Zig. Start the server with `leadline mcp` (stdio); Guard matches the `leadline` executable. Twenty read-only analyzer tools; the only subprocess is a fixed-argument git adapter and the server touches no network. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Launch the server as `leadline mcp` over stdio; `leadline mcp --port` serves the same tools over a local HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1 and is not matched by this entry.
Leave LEADLINE_METRICS_DIR unset to keep the server write-free; when set, point it outside the repository so the opt-in local metrics store never writes into the analyzed tree.
Keep the other row on Review so any tool added in a future leadline release is reviewed until this entry lists it.
Self-updates (`leadline update`) are a separate CLI command that downloads from GitHub; they are never exposed over MCP.
